name: Elicit
summary: AI research assistant for synthesizing scientific evidence.
description: Elicit helps researchers search academic papers, extract data into tables and synthesize evidence for systematic reviews and research reports. It is designed for rigour, with sentence-level citations, and is used by over 7 million researchers. A free plan is available for basic search and summaries, and paid plans add higher limits, data extraction and reports.
